matches.description: Watch Seattle Sounders FC vs Cal highlights and goals from Major League Soccer on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 2, 2026. The MLS season continued on August 2, 2026 , with a high-stakes meeting between Seattle Sounders FC and Cal , bringing together two squads eager to climb the league table. Fans at the stadium were treated to a tactical battle where every inch of the pitch was contested from the opening whistle. Iloski Finds the Breakthrough The match opened with significant physical intensity as both sides looked to establish dominance in the midfield. The competitive nature of the game was highlighted early on when Hassani Dotson received a yellow card in the 12th minute for a heavy challenge. Despite the stop-start nature of the early exchanges, Seattle Sounders FC managed to find their rhythm after the half-hour mark. In the 31st minute, Francis Westfield turned provider, delivering a pinpoint ball to Milan Iloski , who clinicaly dispatched his shot into the target to give his side the lead. Tactical Adjustments and Late Pressure As the second half commenced, the game transformed into a strategic chess match. Both managers looked to their benches to influence the flow of the game, with a flurry of substitutions occurring after the 60th minute. Cal introduced attacking threats like Jesus Ferreira and Peter Kingston in an attempt to claw back into the contest. On the other side, the introduction of veteran Alejandro Bedoya for the talented Cavan Sullivan in the dying minutes provided much-needed composure. The defensive unit held firm through four minutes of stoppage time, ensuring that the early strike was enough to secure the victory when the referee blew the final whistle at 90+4'.
